gen-dafont-stentiga-fs-karma: Refined spacing opens up Stentiga's heading, drawn with plain marker-like strokes. Karma is a serif that narrows gradually from stem to terminal, and that slow taper under marker-plain letters is what makes the pair distinct.
gen-dafont-stentiga-fs-paquito: Stentiga spreads its refined, luxurious letters wide, with generous gaps between them. Paquito is a low serif, with little gap between lowercase and caps, set against a heading whose skeleton outline keeps one fixed stroke thickness.
gen-dafont-stentiga-fs-roundo: Wide-tracked and luxurious, Stentiga stretches every word out across the line. Roundo, plain sans with matching arch and stem on its n and clear little counters, keeps paragraphs moving smoothly at a moderate lowercase height.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-almendra: Almendra, a dignified classic serif with a deep midsection in its lowercase, sits beneath Stentiga's wide-tracked, refined display lines. Its bowls fill out, while the heading's show no swelling at all.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-armata: Armata, a contemporary sans-serif with spacious gaps between characters, supports Stentiga's heading, whose joins are no thinner than its stems. Lowercase bodies filling most of the height keep long text moving.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-golos-text: Approachable and contemporary, the lettering fills its line with a tall x-height and a widely parted s. Golos Text, plain sans built from one stroke width, sits under Stentiga, whose refined display letters are spaced far apart.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-headland-one: Dignified Headland One is a classic serif whose letters sit well apart and whose curves keep real weight at their thinnest. And Stentiga's strokes show no difference between up and side, so the two hold the page together.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text is a classic serif with deep entrances into its curves. Beneath Stentiga's refined heading, whose strokes keep their width from stem to curve, it adds a literary, dignified voice.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-tai-tha: Stentiga's crossbars match its stems, and its tracking runs wide. Noto Sans Tai Tham, a sans-serif with chalk-board lowercase and a clearly visible c interior, keeps whole paragraphs moving.
gen-dafont-stentiga-sora: Wide, spaced, polished: Stentiga's tall lowercase leads, and precise Sora keeps its c and s widely parted. Height against restraint is the draw: tall display lowercase, moderate geometric plain sans.
